name: sKuareWave
summary:
From the inventor of Tunepal comes: sKuareWave: Play Music With Holograms!

sKuareWave is Multi-player, spatial, music creation. 

Wave to Play. Pinch to Program. 
Touch Start, and enter Flow. 
You play the instrument. You are the instrument. 
You create the journey. You are the journey. 

Do not fear mistakes. There are none!

BPM and beat synchronize across  headsets to form a sKuareRave so that players experience a shared musical journey.
